exclusion_detail: The abstract names no single compound ('Eight CDNs showed better activity than 2'3'-cGAMP'; 'the best activities were observed for CDNs bearing large aromatic substituents'), and the follow-up experiments (cytokine induction, four X-ray structures) are spread over several compounds (e.g. 5f, 5k, others), so rules 1 and 2 pick none. In addition the CDNs are made enzymatically from 7-deazapurine nucleoside triphosphates (mostly prepared in earlier work or by Suzuki couplings on nucleotides), so any route would be long or not explicit.

lead.label: none
lead.why: Abstract: 'The best activities were observed for CDNs bearing large aromatic substituents' (a class, not a compound).

notes: Not looked for other qualifying compounds; the series is enzymatic CDN synthesis from NTPs (nucleotides), unlikely to suit the planner.
